title: Erdős #1010 OQ-02: Endpoints and Structure of the Minimum K_r Density Curve (r ≥ 5)
description: De-axiomatizes the Turán forcing step of the parent Erdős #1010 development for every r using Mathlib’s extremal-graph API (exists_clique_of_extremalNumber_lt: more than extremalNumber n K_{r+1} edges forces a K_{r+1}), and pins the provable boundary of the still-unknown K_r density curve g_r(d): the extremal Turán graph has K_{r+1}-density exactly 0 (the lower endpoint), densities live in [0,1], and clique counts are monotone under adding edges. Does not resolve the r ≥ 5 open problem. 0 axioms, 0 sorries.
